attrs.text: The Connection adapter answers `gateway/internal` with empty details for dispatch failures and unclassified exceptions; a `RemoteError` thrown by an owner or by Gateway itself crosses the wire with its own code, message, and details. Its `cause` chain and the `TypertGatewayError` subclass identity survive only for same-process callers.

title: The Gateway exposes each WebSocket stream's inbox capacity and JSON envelope cost through `invocation.uplinkWindow`; carriers without an encoded-frame inbox limit leave it absent. Domain protocols can advertise this window and use acknowled...

attrs.text: The Gateway exposes each WebSocket stream's inbox capacity and JSON envelope cost through `invocation.uplinkWindow`; carriers without an encoded-frame inbox limit leave it absent. Domain protocols can advertise this window and use acknowledgements to bound in-flight bytes. The Gateway itself does not issue credits: a Client that sends faster than the method reads, or that sends to a method never taking its uplink, fails its stream with `gateway/uplink-overflow`, and no uplink item is replayed across carrier generations; a domain that must resume an uplink carries its own acknowledgement cursor in the reopened request.

title: `websocketHeartbeatIntervalMs` is both the Ping cadence and the activity deadline. The Host terminates a peer that shows no activity for two intervals, so a deployment whose event loop or network can stall longer than this interval must rai...

attrs.text: `websocketHeartbeatIntervalMs` is both the Ping cadence and the activity deadline. The Host terminates a peer that shows no activity for two intervals, so a deployment whose event loop or network can stall longer than this interval must raise it.

title: `websocketCompression` defaults to `'deflate'`, which negotiates `permessage-deflate`; the Host compresses its own outbound frames whose JSON text reaches 1,024 characters and leaves shorter frames uncompressed, because `ws` ignores its `th...

attrs.text: `websocketCompression` defaults to `'deflate'`, which negotiates `permessage-deflate`; the Host compresses its own outbound frames whose JSON text reaches 1,024 characters and leaves shorter frames uncompressed, because `ws` ignores its `threshold` option under the default context takeover. A completed compressed downlink write counts as buffered activity for the heartbeat rule, while a sub-threshold write counts only when the local send buffer was already full; a loopback deployment that gains no bandwidth can set it to `'none'`.

title: A completed uncompressed queued write shows that the TCP peer acknowledged data. A compressed write instead completes once `ws` has deflated and written it, so it proves only that the local pipeline drained. Behind a buffering reverse proxy...

attrs.text: A completed uncompressed queued write shows that the TCP peer acknowledged data. A compressed write instead completes once `ws` has deflated and written it, so it proves only that the local pipeline drained. Behind a buffering reverse proxy that peer is the proxy, so a vanished Client during sustained downlink is detected only after the proxy stops accepting data.
